title: Claude, Cameras and the Content Fortress
description: Steven describes his new AI system that turns one podcast recording into transcripts, articles, short clips and translations automatically, and explains why he chose 1080p video and simple tools over new gear. He also covers the IELTS cancellations in mainland China, how his students use AI to practise speaking, and higher pay for YouTube Shorts.

sentences.en: Short summary
Steven is in a very good mood.

sentences.zh: На про́шлой неде́ле он нача́л рабо́тать с Клод через термина́л.
sentences.en: Last week he started working with Claude through the terminal.

sentences.zh: Термина́л — э́то програ́мма, куда́ пи́шут кома́нды для компью́тера.
sentences.en: The terminal is a program where you type commands for the computer.

sentences.zh: С тех пор Сте́вен всё вре́мя про́бует но́вое.
sentences.en: Since then Steven has been trying new things all the time.

sentences.zh: Он говори́т: «Иску́сственный интелле́кт сде́лал рабо́ту интере́сной, как уро́к англи́йского».
sentences.en: He says: "Artificial intelligence has made work interesting, like an English lesson."

sentences.zh: Сего́дня он расска́зывает о но́вой систе́ме.
sentences.en: Today he talks about a new system.
It posts his videos by itself.

sentences.zh: Ещё он говори́т о ка́мерах, о свои́х студе́нтах и об экза́мене IELTS.
sentences.en: He also talks about cameras, his students and the IELTS exam.

sentences.zh: Есть и хоро́шая но́вость о YouTube.
sentences.en: There is also some good news about YouTube.
Lasagna at home
The show starts at the dinner table.

sentences.zh: Подру́га Сте́вена весь день гото́вила лаза́нью.
sentences.en: Steven's girlfriend spent the whole day making lasagna.
It was her third time.

sentences.zh: В пе́рвый раз ма́кароны бы́ли сли́шком мя́гкие.
sentences.en: The first time, the pasta was too soft.

sentences.zh: Во второ́й раз бы́ло ма́ло мясно́го со́уса.
sentences.en: The second time, there wasn't enough meat sauce.
It turned out to be a "noodle pie."
This time everything came out great.
The baking dish wasn't very deep.

sentences.zh: Тогда́ она́ сде́лала высо́кий борт из фо́льги.
sentences.en: So she made a tall rim out of foil.
Claude in the terminal

sentences.zh: Сте́вен мо́жет запуска́ть по четы́ре зада́чи сра́зу.
sentences.en: Steven can run four tasks at once.
He often runs out of his limit.

sentences.zh: Раньше он не выкла́дывал ви́део-ве́рсию подка́ста.
sentences.en: Before, he didn't post a video version of the podcast.

sentences.zh: Ви́део занима́ло мно́го ме́ста и вре́мени.
sentences.en: Video took up a lot of space and time.
Now everything is different.
He puts the video file in a folder.
Then the computer does the rest by itself:
It turns speech into text.
It corrects the text and makes a table of contents.
It writes three articles for Substack.

sentences.zh: Реже́т 12–15 коро́тких вертика́льных ро́ликов и доба́вит субти́тры.
sentences.en: It cuts 12–15 short vertical clips and adds subtitles.

sentences.zh: Гото́вит фа́йл для монта́жа в Final Cut Pro.
sentences.en: It prepares a file for editing in Final Cut Pro.

sentences.zh: Пи́шет кра́ткий текст по-англи́йски, переводи́т его́ на ру́сский и кита́йский и кладёт перево́ды на но́вый сайт.
sentences.en: It writes a short text in English, translates it into Russian and Chinese, and puts the translations on a new website.
There was also some unpleasant news.

sentences.zh: Компа́ния Bluehost присла́ла Сте́вену счёт на 1300 до́лларов за сайт.
sentences.en: The company Bluehost sent Steven a bill for 1,300 dollars for the website.

sentences.zh: Сте́вен говори́т: «Я не собира́юсь э́то плати́ть».
sentences.en: Steven says: "I'm not going to pay that."
Steven thanks the producers.

sentences.zh: Их поже́ртвования помогли́ сде́лать кита́йский сайт с пересказа́ми.
sentences.en: Their donations helped make the Chinese website with summaries.
Will there be an entry fee?
"Not yet."

sentences.zh: Но Сте́вен доба́вит кно́пку для дар.
sentences.en: But Steven will add a donation button.

sentences.zh: Он шу́тит: мо́жет быть, э́то про́сто «прое́кт для себя́».
sentences.en: He jokes: maybe it's just a "project for himself."
But he is proud of it.
Cameras and disk space
Steven has tried five cameras.

sentences.zh: Среди́ них айфон, GoPro и айпад.
sentences.en: Among them are an iPhone, a GoPro and an iPad.

sentences.zh: До про́шлой неде́ли он снима́л на ка́меру ноутбу́ка.
sentences.en: Until last week he was filming with his laptop camera.
It films in 720p quality.
He calls it "2008 quality."
The 4K format won't do.
One episode takes up 17–18 gigabytes.

sentences.zh: Сте́вен шу́тит: «Ра́зве лю́дям на́до ви́деть мои́ морщи́ны?»
sentences.en: Steven jokes: "Do people really need to see my wrinkles?"
He will film in 1080p.

sentences.zh: Если снима́ть в 4K, дис́ки ну́жно ме́нять ка́ждые не́сколько ме́сяцев.
sentences.en: If you film in 4K, you have to replace the disks every few months.

sentences.zh: Но е́сли ви́део выло́жены, то оста́нется па́мять: «Я когда́-то жил на све́те».
sentences.en: But if the videos are posted, a memory will remain: "I once lived in this world."
“The Content Fortress”
Gary Vaynerchuk advises: “Be everywhere.”

sentences.zh: Э́то зна́чит семь–де́вять пу́бликаций в день на семи́–девяти́ сайтах.
sentences.en: That means seven to nine posts a day on seven to nine sites.
Before, that seemed like too much.

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь с иску́сственным интелле́ктом э́то возмо́жно.
sentences.en: Now, with artificial intelligence, it’s possible.

sentences.zh: Но ну́жно созда́ть систе́му и плати́ть за програ́ммы.
sentences.en: But you need to build a system and pay for programs.
Steven tried one app.
Then Facebook locked him out.
It said: “Suspicious activity.”

sentences.zh: Сте́вен шу́тит: «Да, э́то я. Я — тот робот».
sentences.en: Steven jokes: “Yes, that’s me. I’m that robot.”

sentences.zh: В де́тстве Сте́вен мечта́л рабо́тать в му́зыке и́ли в кино́.
sentences.en: As a child, Steven dreamed of working in music or film.

sentences.zh: Он шу́тит: у него́ не вы́росла бы борода́ в 50 сантиме́тров.
sentences.en: He jokes that he could never have grown a 50-centimeter beard.
“Things turned out the way they turned out.”
His “fortress” is this podcast.

sentences.zh: Он запи́сывает его́ ка́ждый бу́дний ве́чер, где бы он ни́ был.
sentences.en: He records it every weekday evening, wherever he is.
Jobs changed, but the podcast stayed.
Platforms and simplicity

sentences.zh: На оди́н эпизо́д ухо́дит о́коло трёх часо́в.
sentences.en: One episode takes about three hours.
An hour for recording.
Then the computer does its work.
Then another hour for editing.

sentences.zh: Снача́ла Сте́вен выкла́дывает ро́лики в TikTok.
sentences.en: First, Steven posts videos on TikTok.
Instagram often deletes accounts like that.

sentences.zh: На YouTube он остаётся с «Steven's Language Vlog».
sentences.en: On YouTube he stays with "Steven's Language Vlog".
Videos with beautiful shots do better.

sentences.zh: Он хоте́л купи́ть ещё компью́тер, объекти́вы и второ́й айфон.
sentences.en: He wanted to buy another computer, lenses and a second iPhone.
But he stopped himself.

sentences.zh: Он сказа́л себе́: «Стиви́, ты ещё не заработа́л на э́том ни рубля́».
sentences.en: He told himself: "Stevie, you haven't earned a single ruble from this yet."
For him, the podcast is "an outlet for the soul".
The number of listeners hasn't changed in a year.

sentences.zh: Поэ́тому он ду́мает о бо́лее то́чных те́мах.
sentences.en: So he is thinking about more specific topics.

sentences.zh: Наприме́р, фина́нсы и исто́рия Росси́и, Украи́ны, Кита́я и Кана́ды.
sentences.en: For example, finance and the history of Russia, Ukraine, China and Canada.
An English lesson or an AI lesson?

sentences.zh: Сте́вен пошути́л над студе́нтами: «Э́то уро́к англи́йского и́ли уро́к ИИ?»
sentences.en: Steven joked with his students: "Is this an English lesson or an AI lesson?"

sentences.zh: В университе́те ИИ запрещён то́лько на экза́менах.
sentences.en: At the university, AI is banned only during exams.
There they write with a pen, without phones.
If they find a phone, the student will be expelled.
"Rules are rules."

sentences.zh: На э́той неде́ле студе́нты рабо́тали па́рами.
sentences.en: This week the students worked in pairs.

sentences.zh: Они́ запи́сывали свою́ речь на телефо́н.
sentences.en: They recorded their speech on a phone.

sentences.zh: Пото́м вставля́ли текст и слайды Сте́вена в DeepSeek.
sentences.en: Then they pasted the text and Steven's slides into DeepSeek.
The program checked their vocabulary and grammar.

sentences.zh: Студе́нты сохраня́ли звук, что́бы слы́шать, как они́ улучша́ются.
sentences.en: The students saved the audio so they could hear how they were improving.

sentences.zh: Сте́вен напо́мнил: ИИ то́же ино́гда не понима́ет речь.
sentences.en: Steven reminded them that AI sometimes doesn't understand speech either.

sentences.zh: Он сра́внивает ИИ с пе́рвыми компью́терами.
sentences.en: He compares AI to the first computers.
"It exists, so why not use it?"

sentences.zh: Он сове́тует студе́нтам взять подпи́ску на семе́стр.
sentences.en: He advises his students to get a subscription for the semester.
The topic "Writing" will start soon.
The story of the cancelled IELTS exams

sentences.zh: Об э́том писа́ли Global Times, China Daily, South China Morning Post и Reddit.
sentences.en: Global Times, China Daily, the South China Morning Post and Reddit all wrote about it.

sentences.zh: Из-за техни́ческой оши́бки в материко́вом Кита́е три–четы́ре дня не рабо́тали экза́мены.
sentences.en: Because of a technical error, the exams in mainland China were down for three or four days.
Now the retakes are underway.
Steven's students weren't affected.

sentences.zh: Сте́вену не нра́вится одна́ фра́за в Global Times.
sentences.en: Steven doesn't like one phrase in Global Times.

sentences.zh: Там отме́ну сравни́ли с матчем, кото́рый отмени́ли по́сле разми́нки.
sentences.en: There, the cancellation was compared to a match called off after the warm-up.
Steven says many people memorize their answers.

sentences.zh: «Если твой англи́йский мо́жно останови́ть отме́ной, э́то пока́зывает твой у́ровень».
sentences.en: "If a cancellation can stop your English, that shows your level."
The trips matter even more.
People travel to another city.
The speaking exam is on a different day.
There are only 300–400 examiners in China.

sentences.zh: Тепе́рь обеща́ют часть де́нег наза́д и по́мощь с пое́здкой.
sentences.en: Now they're promising some money back and help with travel.
YouTube Shorts pays more

sentences.zh: YouTube тепе́рь пла́тит за коро́ткие ро́лики почти́ в два ра́за бо́льше, чем два ме́сяца наза́д.
sentences.en: YouTube now pays almost twice as much for short videos as it did two months ago.

sentences.zh: Дли́нные ви́део пла́тят всё равно́ бо́льше.
sentences.en: Long videos still pay more.
Tomorrow Steven has a day off.

sentences.zh: Он бу́дет монти́ровать ро́лики за́втра и в суббо́ту.
sentences.en: He will edit videos tomorrow and on Saturday.
The main idea

sentences.zh: Иску́сственный интелле́кт сде́лал рабо́ту быстре́е и ве́селее.
sentences.en: Artificial intelligence has made work faster and more fun.
Steven is going to keep things simple.
He won't buy new equipment.
He will keep putting out podcasts.

vocab.en: terminal, a place to type commands
